_doc: Modes (M10). gauntlet: a 17-week season vs League Bosses; strength = the boss starters' target overall, rising from strengthStart (week 1) to strengthEnd (week 17); focus groups get +focusBoost; candidates per slot = the closest pickTop players to the target; bench at strength - benchDrop. playoffWins wins make the playoffs (rounds, the last vs the final boss at playoffStrength). score = wins x winPoints + playoff wins x playoffPoints + point difference (clamped to pointDiffCap). daily: one Triple Draft a day from the same seed for everyone (Quick format, need-based AI drafter), then dailyGames games vs bosses from dailyStrengthStart to dailyStrengthEnd; score = wins x winPoints + point difference. ranked: Elo with eloK, seasons are calendar months, everyone starts at ratingStart; matchmaking pairs players within ratingWindow, widening by windowGrowthPerSec while they wait. trajectoryGuide = the throw aiming guide in ranked games.
